Documented gap profile per underwriter and a team-level competency heat map

checklistGeneric: Assessment completed before any authority increase takes effect
Decision recorded with evidence and approver
System authority updated only after approval
checklistSpecific: Assemble the evidence pack: QA scores, audit findings, referral quality, loss ratio and training completion for the candidate
Run the technical assessment covering the coverage, rating and appetite knowledge required at the target authority level
Review referral decisions the candidate made at the current level for judgement quality, not just outcome
Record the decision (grant / defer / partial) with the approver name and the effective date
Update the authority matrix and the underwriting workstation authority profile to match the approved level

testing.expected: System authority level matches the approved authority matrix entry and effective date
No authority increase applied without a completed and approved assessment record

checklistGeneric: Assessment linked to the specific training event
Pass threshold defined in advance
Results retained against the individual training record
checklistSpecific: Publish the assessment in the LMS against the training event with the defined pass mark
Set questions that test application — rate a sample risk, select the correct form, decide the referral — not recall alone
Record scores per attendee and identify the questions with the lowest cohort pass rate
Schedule remedial coaching for anyone below the pass mark and record the retake date
Feed the weakest question areas back into the next iteration of the training material

testing.expected: Score recorded for every attendee against the training event
No attendee below the pass mark without a scheduled retake or remedial action

checklistGeneric: Cases drawn from real, anonymised files
Attendance captured against individual training records
Agreed outcomes documented and circulated
checklistSpecific: Select anonymised real cases covering the defect categories with the highest QA failure rate
Have participants independently price, form and decide each case before any group discussion
Compare the spread of decisions and surface the reasoning behind the outliers
Agree the correct treatment per case against the guideline and record where the guideline itself was ambiguous
Capture attendance in the LMS and circulate the agreed case treatments as a guidance note

testing.expected: Attendance recorded against each participant training record
Circulated note documenting the agreed treatment for every case discussed

checklistGeneric: Training delivered before the product goes live to underwriters
Attendance logged per individual
Materials retained in the guidance library
checklistSpecific: Build the session around the actual product artefacts: appetite statement, rating plan, form set and referral triggers
Walk a live worked example end to end in the underwriting workstation — quote, rate, form selection, bind
Cover the states in which the product is approved and any state-specific variations or exclusions
Deliver before the product effective date to every underwriter and assistant who will write the line
Log attendance in the LMS and post the deck and worked example to the guidance library

testing.expected: Attendance logged for every underwriter authorised to write the new product
Product training deck and worked example published before the product effective date

checklistGeneric: Programme content mapped to identified competency gaps
Delivery method and duration defined per module
Materials version-controlled and owned
checklistSpecific: Translate the prioritised competency gaps into a module list covering rating mechanics, coverage and forms, and risk analysis
Decide build versus buy per module and confirm any vendor content matches the company guidelines and forms
Define learning objectives, duration, delivery mode and assessment method for each module
Load the modules into the LMS with the target audience and the required completion window
Assign a content owner and a review date per module so material does not drift from current guidelines

testing.expected: Each module published with target audience, objectives and assessment method
No module in the catalogue without a named content owner and review date

checklistGeneric: Module reflects the currently approved guideline version
Changes since the last refresher highlighted explicitly
Module reviewed before release
checklistSpecific: Diff the current underwriting guideline and appetite statement against the version used in the previous refresher
Build the module around what changed: new target classes, newly prohibited classes, revised referral triggers and authority changes
Include the no-write list and the exception route requiring CUO approval
Add scenario questions that force a decision on the changed rules rather than recall of the text
Have the Underwriting Director / Manager review and approve the module content before publishing to the LMS

testing.expected: Module references the current approved guideline and appetite version numbers
Module published with approver name and content review date

checklistGeneric: Rotation planned with a named host and defined objectives
Authority and supervision arrangements confirmed for the rotation
Completion recorded against the training record
checklistSpecific: Identify the specialty and primary lines with succession or single-point-of-knowledge risk
Pair each rotating underwriter with a host senior underwriter and set the learning objectives and duration
Confirm what the rotating underwriter may bind during the rotation and set the supervision and referral arrangements in the workstation
Schedule the rotations so the home desk retains coverage throughout
Debrief at the end of each rotation and record completion and competencies evidenced on the training record

testing.expected: Rotation schedule with host, objectives, dates and supervision arrangement
No completed rotation missing its debrief and competency record

checklistGeneric: Records tie to the individual licence and state requirement
Shortfalls identified before the compliance deadline
Certificates retained as evidence
checklistSpecific: Maintain the roster of licensed underwriters with each state licence, licence number and CE reporting period end
Record completed CE hours per individual with credit type and the provider certificate attached
Compare hours completed against each state requirement including any ethics or line-specific sub-requirements
Flag anyone projected to fall short with more than 60 days to the deadline and assign the courses needed
Reconcile the internal record against the state or NIPR CE transcript before the reporting deadline

testing.expected: Completed CE hours with certificates recorded against each licensed underwriter
No licensed underwriter short of the state CE requirement inside the deadline window

checklistGeneric: Plan reviewed on a defined cadence with leadership
Every critical role has at least one identified successor
Plan stored with restricted access
checklistSpecific: List the critical underwriting roles — CUO, line leads, senior underwriters holding the highest authority and specialty single-point roles
Name ready-now and ready-later successors for each role with the readiness gap stated
Link each readiness gap to a development action — rotation, authority progression, targeted training
Review with the CUO and refresh the readiness ratings for the period
Store the refreshed plan in the restricted-access leadership library with the review date

testing.expected: Current plan with named successors and readiness ratings for every critical role
No critical underwriting role without an identified successor

checklistGeneric: Framework versioned with an owner and review date
Competencies expressed at defined proficiency levels
Framework aligned to the authority matrix
checklistSpecific: Review each competency definition against current products, systems and guidelines and retire anything obsolete
Express each competency at the proficiency levels tied to authority tiers so progression criteria are objective
Add competencies for newly introduced products, rating tools and regulatory obligations
Confirm the framework maps cleanly onto the authority matrix so no authority tier lacks defined competencies
Publish the updated framework with a new version number, owner and next review date

testing.expected: Current framework version with owner, approval date and next review date
No authority tier in the matrix without defined competencies at the required proficiency

checklistGeneric: Comparison uses the same scoring rubric before and after
Measurement window defined and consistent
Result reported back to the training owner
checklistSpecific: Fix the measurement windows — QA defect rate for the cycle before training and the cycle after, using the same rubric version
Compare defect rate per trained underwriter, isolated to the defect categories the training targeted
Control for sample size so a small post-training sample is not read as improvement
Identify individuals with no improvement and route them to coaching or an authority review
Report the improvement metrics to the training owner and into the quarterly QA report

testing.expected: Defect rate before and after training shown per trained underwriter and defect category
Recorded improvement metric linked to the specific training event

checklistGeneric: Completion recorded from the system, not self-declaration
Sign-off performed by the line manager
Overdue completions escalated
checklistSpecific: Reconcile LMS completion records against the assigned target audience for every mandatory module
Chase incomplete assignments before the completion deadline and record the chase
Obtain line-manager competency sign-off where the module gates an authority level or product
Record the sign-off with manager name and date against the individual training record
Escalate anyone still incomplete after the deadline to the Underwriting Director / Manager

testing.expected: No assigned underwriter showing incomplete status past the completion deadline
Manager sign-off recorded for every authority-gating module completion

checklistGeneric: Alignment evidenced in an agreed document, not a conversation
Underwriting limits reconcile to the enterprise risk appetite
Any divergence recorded with a rationale and an owner
checklistSpecific: Map the underwriting appetite statement limits to the enterprise risk appetite metrics and tolerances
Reconcile underwriting catastrophe, aggregate and single-risk limits to the enterprise capital and reinsurance constraints
Confirm underwriting quality KRIs feed the enterprise risk register rather than sitting only in the QA pack
Agree with risk and actuarial where the frameworks diverge and record the divergence with an owner and resolution date
Record the alignment confirmation in the governance minutes and update the risk register linkage

testing.expected: Underwriting risks and KRIs linked to enterprise risk appetite metrics
Minuted confirmation that underwriting limits reconcile to the enterprise risk appetite

checklistGeneric: Archived to the retention schedule with a disposal date
Final approved versions archived, not drafts
Access controlled and auditable
checklistSpecific: Collect the signed minutes, committee papers and approved policy documents for each governance meeting in the period
Confirm the archived version is the final approved version and remove superseded drafts from the working folder
Index each record by committee, meeting date and decision reference so decisions are retrievable by reference
Apply the retention class from the records retention schedule and set the disposal review date
Restrict access to the governance record set and confirm the permission list is current

testing.expected: Signed minutes and approved papers archived for every meeting in the period
No archived governance record without a retention class and disposal review date

checklistGeneric: Pack compiled from the systems of record, not manual re-keying
Every exception shows its approver and authority basis
Pack issued ahead of the committee deadline
checklistSpecific: Extract the authority deviation log for the period showing each deviation, the approver and the authority basis
Extract appetite exceptions and confirm each carries the CUO approval required by the appetite standard
Summarise QA findings by severity with movement against the prior period
Highlight repeat exceptions by the same underwriter or the same class as a control-weakness theme
Assemble the consolidated pack with an executive summary of themes and circulate ahead of the committee papers deadline

testing.expected: No appetite exception recorded without the required CUO approval
Consolidated exception and QA pack issued before the papers deadline

checklistGeneric: Single controlled location holds the current approved version
Every document has an owner, approver and review date
Superseded versions withdrawn from circulation
checklistSpecific: Review the underwriting policy and standards inventory and confirm each document owner and approver is still current
Check every document against its scheduled review date and start the review of anything due or overdue
Apply version control: increment the version, record the change summary and the approval date on the front sheet
Withdraw superseded versions from the guidance library so underwriters cannot open an out-of-date guideline
Publish the current inventory showing document, version, owner, approval date and next review date

testing.expected: Current approved version of every policy with owner, approver and next review date
No superseded policy version still published in the guidance library

checklistGeneric: KRIs measured against approved thresholds, not moving targets
Breaches escalated within the defined timeframe
Review evidenced with a date and reviewer
checklistSpecific: Refresh the underwriting quality KRIs — QA defect rate, authority breach count, referral compliance, file documentation completeness, rate conformity exceptions
Compare each KRI against its green/amber/red threshold and record the RAG status for the period
For every red KRI, confirm an escalation record exists with an owner and a remediation action
Check trend direction over the last four periods to catch a metric deteriorating inside the green band
Record the KRI review with the reviewer name and date and feed the results into the governance pack

testing.expected: RAG status against threshold for every defined underwriting quality KRI
No red KRI without a raised escalation record and named owner

checklistGeneric: Pack assembled from source dashboards and registers
Prior-meeting actions status included
Pack circulated by the published deadline
checklistSpecific: Assemble the standing sections: portfolio performance, appetite utilisation, QA and audit summary, exceptions, and KRI dashboard
Include the status of every action from the previous committee with owner and due date
Add the emerging-issue section covering new products, regulatory change and any systemic quality theme
Reconcile the numbers in the pack to the source dashboards before issue
Circulate the pack to committee members by the papers deadline and file it to the governance library

testing.expected: Quarterly pack containing performance, appetite, QA/audit and prior-action status sections
Pack figures reconcile to the source dashboard values at the stated cut-off date

checklistGeneric: Report approved by the CUO before board submission
Appetite utilisation shown against approved limits
Emerging risks stated with the management response
checklistSpecific: Summarise material exposures — largest aggregates, catastrophe accumulations, single-risk concentrations — against approved limits
Show appetite utilisation by line and class with any breach or near-breach called out explicitly
Describe emerging risks and the underwriting response — appetite change, wording change, rate action, reinsurance action
Include the underwriting quality position: QA defect trend, open audit findings and repeat findings
Obtain CUO approval and submit to the board pack by the submission deadline

testing.expected: Issued board underwriting risk report with CUO approval and submission date
Utilisation against approved appetite limits for every line reported to the board

checklistGeneric: Every decision has an owner, action and due date
Actions tracked in a register, not only in minutes
Closure evidenced before the item is marked complete
checklistSpecific: Extract decisions and actions from the committee minutes and log each one in the governance action register
Assign a named owner and a due date to every action — no action assigned to a team or a function alone
Age open actions and produce the overdue list ahead of each committee meeting
Require closure evidence (updated guideline, system change reference, report issued) before an action is marked complete
Report action status and overdue items as a standing item in the next committee pack

testing.expected: No open action without a named individual owner and a due date
Every minuted decision has a corresponding action register entry

checklistGeneric: Guideline change traceable to the governance decision reference
Change approved by the documented approval authority
Underwriters notified before the change takes effect
checklistSpecific: Translate each committee decision into the specific guideline clause change — appetite class, referral trigger, authority limit or documentation requirement
Draft the change with the decision reference and effective date recorded in the change history table
Obtain approval from the documented approval authority for the guideline document
Publish the new version to the guidance library and withdraw the superseded version
Issue the change notification to underwriters and update the referral trigger configuration in the workstation to match

testing.expected: Each guideline change records the governance decision reference, approver and effective date
Configured referral triggers match the current approved guideline version
